title: Egypt, *privately.*
subtitle: A discreet on-ground partner in Egypt for CAA Base clients and their families. You keep the client and the relationship; NOYA handles Egypt, under your name if you prefer.

blocks.text: A discreet on-ground partner in Egypt for your clients. You keep the client and the relationship. NOYA handles Egypt privately, under your name if you prefer.

rows: An agency representing more than 300 international players, coaches and managers, with offices across four continents.

blocks.label: What we arrange
blocks.title: For your clients and their families.

right.title: NOYA delivers in Egypt
items: VIP airport meet and assist, private chauffeur and secure transport
Cultural access: Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum, Luxor, Aswan and the Nile
The Red Sea, El Gouna and the North Coast

items.title: Introduce
items.text: Share the request privately with your NOYA lifestyle manager.

items.title: Tailor
items.text: We research, coordinate and present the most suitable options around preferences, timing and requirements.

items.title: Approve
items.text: You select and approve the preferred arrangement before confirmation.

items.title: Experience
items.text: NOYA manages the details from confirmation through to completion, remaining available throughout.

rows: Personal details, travel plans and requests are handled with care and discretion.
Every relationship is managed individually, with service shaped around personal preferences and expectations.
We work through a carefully selected network of hospitality, travel, lifestyle and sourcing partners.
Requests are coordinated through direct communication with your lifestyle manager.
Specialist support in Egypt, supported by an international network across key destinations.

blocks.text: We never name clients, and nothing is shared without your consent. Properties are proposed on what each one can confirm about privacy, access and security.

items.title: A private call
items.text: Fifteen minutes to understand how your team handles client requests today.

items.title: NOYA on file
items.text: One contact and one line for any Egypt request, under your name if you prefer.
